book.name: 1 TESALONAIKA
book.title: Tesalonaika wali Leta Houwan Pol wana Leleli

content: Nuku Silawa ge Nuku Lovivina Babala wana Sikalim kaiwena
Talimeyau ge numeyau, nige bosowaina naha leleli eliyamiu ge naha ba hauna sauga ge hauna lan bugul bolo ya nihi gan,
kaiwena ku atena bubun te Babala wana lan sikalim ana sauga ni ola tokaoma wana vin bulin gamwana.

Sauga gamagalau nihi ba, “Panuwa iyaka i bakuhu ge ta mibubun,” yaka sauga o nak etega ni gan ge ni apanakil. Atiyou elana ni masal eliyalil, ni ola ab lomwanina i masal yova elana. He nige nihi lolou luwai.
Talimeyau ge numeyau, komiu nige ku miminaa gogouwa, ge tage lan o atemiu ni payou ni ola tokaoma.
Komiu gegewemiu lan ge mwananal natunau. Kila nige bulin ge gogou ana labi gamagaliliyau i oola.
Inoke kila bahi ta kekenu ni oola gamagalau gegewel, yaa ta silawa ge totola ta kaisela nak elana.
Kaiwena bolo hi kenu, bulina te hi kenu, ge bolo hi im kokona, bulina te hi im kokona.

Yaa kila lan ana labi gamagaliliyau, inoke totola ta kaisela nak elana. Abulilek ge nunuwana paganina ta ahe ta galoil, ni ola tolohaveyan babagalina ana eteli kaus i galoi. I ola al, atimatuwa paganina ge ta matamatan Yehoba ni pwamwalila, ta ahe ta pom ni ola ala hat gasigasisena.
Kaiwena Yehoba nige i hihilela ge wana huga lomwanina amnana ta anbose, yaa i hilela ge wala Babala Yeisu Keliso eliyana pwamwal ta ahe.
Yeisu i yaomal kaiwela, inoke sauga ni sikalim, bwagana yawalila miminana o ebo iyaka ta yaomal, gegewela yawalila ni gan ge avala ta mina.
Inoke alomiyau nuku ba pagasisi-agil ge wali abulilek nuku tal pamatuwa, ni ola te ku giginol.
Toabulilek ali Ba Pagasisi Enuna
Talimeyau ge numeyau, nuwama naha ba eliyamiu te bolo hi tuwalaliya gamwamiwa nuku awatauwagil. Heliya hi houwa-agimiu Babala wana tuwalali eliyana ge hi panpankiti eliyamiu.
Tuwalali toto hi awaawaginol ana nuwatu i bwata, inoke nuku hehegan bubun elal ge nuku nunuwana-agil nabiyan. Alomiyau ge alomiyau nuku mibubun.

Talimeyau ge numeyau, ha ba pagasisi-agimiu te bolo hi nonobwagabwaga ge nige hi tutuwalali nuku pahenapol, topulupuluwawi nuku ba pagasisel, bolo hi pweyata nuku label, ge gamagalau gegewel wali lopalapalaviyan nuku palahikan.
Nuku matahikagimiu ebo gamagal etega ni ginol panak eliyamiu, bahi komiu etega ni giginol lahe elana. Yaa nuku labose sauga gegewena wami pagan ni waisi alomiyau elal ge gamagalau gegewel elal.
Sauga gegewena nuku yaliyaya,
sauga gegewena nuku awaawanun,
ge bwagana hauna gun ebo ni masal eliyamiu, nuku ba mulolu Yehoba elana. Kaiwena komiu bolo ku minaa Keliso Yeisu elana, Yehoba wana nuwatu kaiwemiu i ola to.
Yayaluwa Bwabwalena wana tuwalali eliyamiu bahi nuku pwapwabolu.
Ebo gamagal etega ni palopisai
eliyamiu, bahi nuku aawa nanakan ge nuku babaa, “Ginol o nige i wawaisi.”
Ginol ge baaba gegewena nuku hile bubun. Toto ebo ni waisi nuku kukuhikan,
yaa nak tomaha tomaha nuku towaagil.

Ya awanun Yehoba, iya mibubun ana Yabowaine, totona ni pwabwabwalena-agimiu ge wami pagan gegewena ni sapu hot. Ya awanun Yehoba bwabwaligemiu, yayaluwamiu, yawalimiu ge tuwamiu, ni matahikan, inoke sauga wala Babala Yeisu Keliso ni sikalim, nige ami woliwoli etega ni gagan.
Bosowaina Yehoba, iya i yogaagimiu, ana mel nuku teli ge ni ginol ola kaiwemiu.
Talimeyau ge numeyau, nuku awanun kaiwema.
Nimamiu nuku paelu wami pan toabulilek gegewel elal ge nuku pemumulolu-agimiu, kaiwena komiu Yehoba wana gamagalau.
Babala alana elana ya ba pagasisi-agimiu leta ya nuku vasili toabulilek gegewel elal.
Wala Babala Yeisu Keliso wana mulolu ni minaa eliyamiu.

footnotes.text: Ta palopisai ana sapu heiya te Yehoba totona wana baaba ta baubaunan gamagalau elal.
